page.layout: One printed page of text, single column, with theses numbered in roman numerals. Top: "IIX." then the thesis "Grammatica origine est prior" and "IX." Then the theses IX, X, XI, and XII, each followed by its text. Below XII: the heading "TOTIVS PHILOSOPHIAE CONCLVSIO." and a paragraph beginning with a large initial Q, ending with two footnotes marked a and b. No margins with text.

main_text.p: Grammatica origine est prior:Logica vero perfe-ctione.

LOgica utrum Philosophiæ pars, an vero instrumentum ; Ars itidem, an vero Scientia sit appellanda ? acriter inter se disputant. Pro Instrumento & Arte pugnarunt nobiles Philosophi. Sed quid obstat, quo minus partem tueamur utramq; ? Ammonius in præf. Com. in Categorias.

Logicæ autem in partes distributio, partiumq; πρῶτα διαιρετικά[?] studiose exquiri solent. Nos, si ἐπέχειν[?] non liceat, Peripateticam cum Auerroe acutissimo Hispano, &c. in Communem & Propriam. In Præf. in Analyt. post.
Vellem singula minutius : verum in campos Medicinæ latissimos auocatus, hoc quidem tempore non possum. Potero deinceps, ubi vitam & vires concesserit Deus : cui honor & gloria uniuersa.
main_text.head: TOTIVS PHILOSOPHIAE CONCLVSIO.

p.i: QVandoquidē igitur Oratio et Ratio ea ipsa sunt, quibus Homines appellamur, ad Deum quam proxime accedimus, à bestijs vero recedimus & differimus, atq; beamur: a nemo aliquid vitio nobis vertat, si in hisce excolendis, exornandis perficiendisq; toti incubuerimus, ut quid in nobis diuinissimum præstantissimumq; existat, tandem opere & re cognoscamus & celebremus. Illa porro LOGICAM docere, nemo inficiabitur. Cur ergo quæ {a}Aristotelis principis in hoc argumenti genere {b}sunt XVI. ORGANI Libris comprehensa, discutienda non proponam? ut tandem experiar, num Oratione & Ratione perfectissime utar.

page.notes: The Greek words after "partiumq;" and "si" are doubtful; the printed letters look like πρῶτα διαιρετικά and ἐπέχειν but I cannot read them with certainty. The marker before "Aristotelis" is a small sign and its letter is uncertain, so I gave it as a. The mark "a" before "nemo" is read as printed. "IIX." is printed as is.
